g.text: Which KRAS variants can ADAR correct?

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7f8c8d

g.text: ADAR deaminates adenosine to inosine, read as guanosine. Only G>A driver changes can be reversed directly.
